protocol.checkpoint_selection: check Macro-AUPR for all new models, matching reused baseline
protocol.training_sampler: natural 8000 without replacement per epoch, independent of 32000 identity pool
protocol.D_loss: SawFM/MFT/ISRJ weak positives 1.5x; divide each label by fit-only expected weight mass
protocol.FMB_rule: fixed same-seed previous combo model at sigmoid0.5, identical across A/B/C/D
protocol.other_labels_rule: candidate per-label F1 thresholds fit only on unchanged calibration
protocol.secondary_decision: candidate empirical calibration FP caps matched to same-seed A F1 counts; FMB remains fixed0.5
protocol.candidate_selection: highest check mean fusion Exact among B/C/D satisfying check tail-F1 drop<=0.003 and max mean class-FPR rise<=0.01; must exceed A check Exact
protocol.confirmation: only selected-on-check candidate is primary; other contrasts exploratory
protocol.report_gate: all15 trainings complete; all25 checkpoint and decision hashes plus candidate frozen before any new report inference
protocol.report_distribution: original independent10--30dB component JNR; conditional augmentation is fit-only
protocol.generator: v3 physical-equation Python PCG64 port, not bitwise MATLAB parity
protocol.power_truth_input: training loss and evaluation only; inference only I/Q
